p.CARRIER: The schema-1 TOML sidecar declares namespace, toolchain, explicit sources in dependency-first order, allowed_axioms, optional timeout_seconds, and one or more [[proof]] bindings. Each proof names subject, spec_file, optional spec_revision, module, theorem and grade. It uses ordinary idiomatic Lean without source annotation syntax. The mapping declares verifies relationships only; scan does not check theorem existence or proof success.

p.NAMED-DECLARATION: A proof binding selects a module and fully qualified theorem name from a strict ASCII dotted-identifier subset: each component starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits, underscore or apostrophe. Quoted and Unicode selectors are unsupported in 0.1.0; ordinary Lean source syntax is not replaced or globally restricted by that selector boundary. check resolves the named theorem through elaboration. Anonymous examples, comments, absent declarations and arbitrary non-theorem definitions cannot stand in for it. Scan declarations are not checked witnesses.

p.SUBJECT: subject is the exact full spec://group/package/document#anchor URI. namespace is a fully qualified group/package coordinate with the admitted LDH naming grammar, and spec_file identifies its local Markdown or XML source. The shared core parser validates exact URI, actual authored revision and unit content identity. Omit spec_revision only when the source is unrevisioned: absent is None, never an inferred revision 1. No partial-name or first-theorem fallback is permitted.

p.SCHEMA: Top-level fields: schema = 1; namespace = "org.example/demo"; toolchain = "leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1"; sources = ["Example.lean"]; allowed_axioms = []; optional timeout_seconds = 30. Each [[proof]] has subject = "spec://org.example/demo/Protocol#identity", spec_file = "vibevm/vibespecs/Protocol.md", optional spec_revision = 1 matching the source, module = "Example", theorem = "Example.identity", grade = "g1_model". The carrier is strict/versioned; malformed, ambiguous or unsupported inputs must fail. There is no implicit Rust symbol binding.

p.AUTHORITY: A carrier contains nonsecret source/subject metadata. It does not contain credentials and cannot confer Owner, coordinator, native-host or work-acceptance authority.
